added_steps:
- name: Generate current physical Hybrid P4 reports
        run: python ../scripts/generate_hybrid_physical_ci_pdfs.py --output hybrid-physical-pdfs
      - name: Upload current physical Hybrid P4 reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: hybrid-physical-pdfs-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: backend/hybrid-physical-pdfs/
          if-no-files-found: error
test_count_basis: Actual collected tests; full execution is a separate mandatory gate.

inactive_boundary_guard.new_condition: if path.name not in new_names and path not in approved_p4_paths:
inactive_boundary_guard.scope: Existing HYB1 contracts and R3 geometry helpers only; no RHM reference capacity borrowing or other module import permission.
